setting__play_on_url_fail_strategy_tip: Refresh URL and retry: fetch the link again at the same quality, the count is set by "URL refresh limit" (this is the default behavior). Retry at a lower quality: on each failure, step one level down the quality ladder, e.g. flac → 320k → 128k. Skip without retrying: show the error and skip after the delay set below, without fetching again.
setting__play_wy_fallback: Fall back to NetEase when no playable URL is found
setting__play_wy_fallback_tip: When QQ Music returns no playable URL (VIP-only, exclusive, removed), the same song is played silently from NetEase Cloud Music instead: no message, and the source label, lyrics and cover stay unchanged, so the switch is invisible. Only versions whose title, artist and duration all match (within 5 seconds) are used; when nothing matches, the usual error/skip happens. Quality is fixed at 128k, the only tier available without an account.
setting__play_power_save_blocker: Prevent device from hibernating while playing songs
setting__play_stability_group_tip: All durations are in seconds and take effect immediately, no restart needed. The "Automatically switch songs when playback error occurs" switch only gates three of them: the load failure retry interval, the URL fetch timeout, and the delay before auto-skip (plus the auto-skip that follows a stall skip running to the end of the track). The other items are independent of it.

setting__data_cache_policy_group_tip: Only the streaming URL cache is recycled. Playlists, liked songs, backups and downloaded audio files are never touched. Recycling runs once at every startup with the values below, and whenever you press "Recycle now". With both values at 0 nothing is recycled automatically and no cache entry is ever deleted.
setting__data_cache_music_url_keep_days_: Cached URLs older than this many days are deleted when recycling runs, and re-fetched on the next play. 0 = never clean up by age (default). Age counts from the moment the URL was cached and is not refreshed by cache hits, so a song you have not re-fetched for a long time will be cleaned up once it expires — the only cost is one extra URL fetch.
setting__data_cache_max_size_tip: When the cache exceeds this limit, the oldest URLs are deleted until it fits. 0 = unlimited (default). Usage is estimated from the id and URL length of each entry and excludes database overhead, so the real size is slightly larger than this number.
setting__data_cache_recycle_none: Both values are 0: nothing to recycle and no cache entry is deleted. Set either one to a non-zero value to enable recycling at startup and via "Recycle now".
setting__data_cache_recycle_failed: Recycling failed, check the main process log for details
setting__data_lyric_offset_tip: Adjusts the lyric offset of the currently playing song: right-click the lyrics on the play page to fine-tune by ±10 / ±100 ms or reset. Adjusted lyrics are counted in the Cache & Cleanup group above and can be cleared in bulk.
setting__data_cache_row_music_url_tip: Clears the cached streaming URLs; songs are re-fetched on the next play and nothing is deleted.
setting__data_cache_row_lyric_raw_tip: Clears the cached raw lyrics; they are fetched again on the next play.
setting__data_cache_row_lyric_edited_tip: Clears the offset records you adjusted in the lyric context menu, restoring their original timeline. A confirmation is shown before clearing.
setting__network_proxy_host_tip: Proxy hostname or IP. If left empty, the proxy stays inactive even when enabled.
setting__network_proxy_port_tip: Proxy port. Defaults to 80 when left empty.
setting__open_api_bind_lan_tip: Binds the service to 0.0.0.0, so any device on the LAN can call it without authentication. Enable only when needed.
setting__sync_server_max_snapshot_num_ti: How many sync snapshots the server keeps for each user (at least 1). Lowering it drops older snapshots and shortens the sync history.
setting__advanced_audio_visualization_ti: Audio visualization at the bottom of the play detail page; it is a separate switch from the one in the desktop lyric window. Enabling it resets the audio output device to the default one.
setting__advanced_sound_effect_panel_ite: The following items are adjusted in the sound effect panel (click to open it):
setting__basic_font_tip: The left list is the primary font, the right one the fallback used for missing glyphs. Affects the main window only; the desktop lyric window has its own font.
setting__basic_window_size_tip: Main window width (7 steps). The main window cannot be resized by dragging, so this is the only way to change its size. Locked in fullscreen.
setting__basic_start_in_fullscreen_tip: Start in fullscreen. While this is on, "Window size" and "Interface font size" are locked.
setting__basic_playbar_progress_style_ti: Switches the whole play bar layout (mini / middle / full), not the thickness of the progress bar; the bar is re-laid out after switching.
setting__help_shared_with_lyric_window: The main window and the desktop lyric window share this value — changing it here affects both.
setting__play_startup_auto_play_tip: Only applies when the previously playing song is restored; if playback was paused when you quit, it stays paused after restoring.
setting__play_power_save_blocker_tip: Keeps the system from sleeping while playing. After pausing, the blocker is released 90 seconds later (so it is not re-requested on every track change).
setting__play_save_play_time_tip: Remembers the playback position of each song and resumes there next time. Only for songs in your own lists; throwaway lists such as online playlists and rankings are not tracked.
setting__play_auto_skip_on_error_tip: The master switch for error tolerance. Turning it off disables all four: retrying failed streams, the stream-fetch timeout, auto-skip after a failure and stall skipping — playback stops where it failed instead of switching songs.
setting__play_toggle_play_method_tip: Sets the order of previous/next (list loop / shuffle / in order / repeat one / no auto-advance). Same value as the mode button on the play bar.
setting__play_lyric_s2t_tip: Converts Chinese lyrics to traditional characters (it does not switch language), and it also affects downloaded .lrc files and lyrics embedded into audio, not just what is displayed.
setting__play_detail_font_zoom_tip: Enlarges the line currently being sung. Independent from the desktop lyric window's "zoom current line".
setting__play_detail_lyric_delay_scroll_: Waits about 600ms after the current line ends before scrolling, which is steadier for long lines and slow songs. Separate from the desktop lyric delay setting.
setting__play_detail_align_tip: The lyric right-click menu changes the same value (both stay in sync). Independent from the desktop lyric alignment.
setting__play_playQuality_tip: From highest to lowest: Hi-Res (flac24bit) → lossless (flac) → high (320k) → standard (128k). Playback uses the closest tier that the song actually has and the source supports (pick Hi-Res for a song that only has 320k and it plays 320k); if none are available it falls back to 128k. Lossless and Hi-Res usually require a matching membership.
setting__play_mediaDevice_tip: Conflicts with audio visualization, sound effects and max channel count: while those advanced audio features are on, this option is unavailable — turn them off and restart the app first.
setting__play_max_output_channel_count_t: If a non-default output device is selected when you turn this on, it is reset to the default device after a confirmation. Conflicts with sound effects / audio visualization.
setting__play_retry_url_max_num_tip: How many times a failed stream URL is refreshed; 0 = never (same as "no retry"). With the "degrade" strategy it also caps how many tiers it may step down.
setting__play_retry_url_delay_tip: If loading takes longer than this without audio, the URL is refreshed once and playback retried (25 s before this became configurable).
setting__play_get_url_timeout_tip: Total time allowed for one stream fetch, including degrade retries; longer than this counts as a failure (100 s before this became configurable).
setting__play_error_skip_delay_tip: How long to wait before auto-skipping to the next song after an error. When the window is not visible (minimized/background) it skips immediately.
setting__play_stall_skip_threshold_tip: If buffering makes no progress for this long, playback starts skipping forward (3 s before this became configurable).
setting__play_stall_skip_range_tip: Random range (min / max, seconds) for how far each stall skip jumps. Reversed values are not an error — the app uses them by size.
setting__play_skip_step_seconds_tip: How many seconds each fast-forward/rewind jumps (used by both the shortcuts and the system media keys; 5 s before this became configurable).
setting__play_volume_step_tip: How much the volume shortcuts change the volume each press (4% before this became configurable).
setting__desktop_lyric_lock_screen_tip: While on, the lyric window is kept inside the main screen and cannot be dragged out. Turn it off to place the lyrics on a secondary monitor.
setting__desktop_lyric_audio_visualizati: Audio visualization at the bottom of the lyric window; independent from the main window's. If the output device is not the default when you turn it on, it is reset after a confirmation.
setting__desktop_lyric_pause_hide_tip: Fades the lyrics (higher transparency) while paused and restores them on resume; if the lyrics seem to have "disappeared", this is usually why.
setting__desktop_lyric_delay_scroll_tip: Waits about 600ms after the current line ends before scrolling. Separate from the main window's delay setting.
setting__desktop_lyric_scroll_align_tip: Only used in the vertical layout: whether the current line scrolls to the top of the window or stays centered.
setting__desktop_lyric_align_tip: Alignment for the desktop lyric window; independent from the main window's lyric alignment.
setting__desktop_lyric_line_gap_tip: Spacing between lyric lines (0–25). Most noticeable in the vertical layout.
setting__desktop_lyric_font_zoom_tip: Enlarges the line currently being sung. Independent from the main window's "zoom the currently playing lyrics".
setting__download_path_tip: Folder where downloads are saved (a missing folder or one without write permission makes downloads fail). Changing it does not move files already downloaded.
setting__sync_mode_tip: Server: this machine stores the data and waits for others to connect. Client: this machine connects to someone else's server. While sync is on, the mode and port cannot be changed — turn sync off first.
setting__lyric_source_priority: Lyric source priority for local songs
setting__lyric_source_priority_tip: Applies to local songs only (online songs have no local lyrics to look up). Both options only decide which side is looked up first: if that side has nothing or the request fails, the other side is used as a fallback — it is not disabled.
setting__lyric_source_priority_localFirs: Local lyrics first (same-folder .lrc and cached lyrics)
setting__list_page_size_tip: How many items each list loads at a time (10 / 20 / 30 / 50 / 100, default 30). Changing it does not refresh lists that are already loaded — it takes effect on the next page load or pagination. Exceptions: "Recommended playlists" on the Discover page stays at 9 items (needed to fill 3 cards per row), and the Playlist Square and Charts in Music Hall stay at 36 / 300 items — none of the three follows this setting.
setting__search_history_max_num_tip: How many search history entries are kept (0–100, default 15). 0 = do not record history (existing entries stay; new words are simply not saved). New searches go to the top and duplicates are stored once.
